name: AddClimaxes
description: Use when the player describes, as part of the story, the speaking NPC climaxing a number of times that was not an actual in-game scene, for example 'we went at it for four days and you came a hundred times'. Pass how many times. Do not use for climaxes that just happened in the current scene; those are counted already.
note: Needs OSL Aroused, Mantella Living World - Arousal and Mantella's Advanced Actions on (tool calling). Adds to the NPC's climax count toward being satisfied. Only offered to NPCs close to the player.

count.description: How many times the speaking NPC climaxed in what the player described. Use the player's number if given; otherwise estimate from what was described.

prompt: If the player describes you climaxing a number of times in the story, begin your response with '{key}:'
